findings.title: Exposed Cryptographic Private Key
findings.evidenceSummary: Detected secret in gitleaks.adapter.ts line 45: -----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY----- [REDACTED SECRET BYTES] -----END PRIVATE KEY-----
findings.rawSnippet: mask: () => '-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY----- [REDACTED SECRET BYTES] -----END PRIVATE KEY----- [REDACTED SECRET BYTES] -----END PRIVATE KEY-----',
findings.remediation: Immediately revoke and rotate the exposed credential. Store secrets strictly in environment variables or a secrets manager (e.g. AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault).
